text: {"edits": [{"finding_ids": ["app/tickets.py:16:int-to-str-coercion"], "search": "    model_config = ConfigDict(str_strip_whitespace=True)", "replace": "    model_config = ConfigDict(str_strip_whitespace=True, coerce_numbers_to_str=True)", "explanation": "Pydantic v2 no longer coerces int inputs to str fields by default (the test failure is string_type on int input). Pydantic v1 silently coerced int to str, and the DB driver returns integer ids. Setting ConfigDict(coerce_numbers_to_str=True) restores the v1 behavior inside the model, so from_db_rows and its callers stay unchanged. Per the migration docs, coerce_numbers_to_str is the v2 setting for int/float/Decimal-to-str coercion, which is disabled by default."}], "notes": "The config-class finding (app/tickets.py:11) is already resolved by the previous attempt: `class Config` was replaced with `model_config = ConfigDict(str_strip_whitespace=True)`, and anystr_strip_whitespace was renamed correctly, so no edit is needed for it. The failure comes from v2 not coercing int to str. The chosen fix is a model-level config flag, which keeps from_db_rows unchanged and preserves v1 behavior. The alternative was to wrap the values with str() in from_db_rows, but that moves the coercion out of the model. No imports need to change because ConfigDict is already imported. The test does not check whitespace behavior beyond the existing str_strip_whitespace setting, which is left as-is."}
